Coram : V. GOPALA GOWDA*, UDAY UMESH LALIT
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985: ss.18, 50 - Appellant suspected to be in possession of opium without any permit or licence - Opted search in presence of Gazetted Officer - Personal search undertaken and recovery of opium weighing 1 Kg. - Courts below convicted him u/s.18 - ground that the investigation was conducted by Sub-Inspector who himself was the complainant and therefore investigation was not proper and appellant was entitled to acquittal - Held: The search of the appellant was conducted in the presence of and under the instructions of the Gazeued Officer -
Decision Date : 19-01-2016 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 50/2016 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
